description.en:
Terraform Plus - Terrain measurement and profile analysis.
Features: - Terrain height measurement - Two-point slope measurement - Terrain profile analysis - Visual markers and reference lines - Read-only terrain analysis

Terraform Plus - Gelaendehoehenmessung und Profilanalyse.
